evidence.why: Attributes are read as physics inputs.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's claim that common movement attributes are updated in place.
facts.value: Per-frame fighter physics callback with signature void(Fighter_GObj* gobj). It forwards the object to ft_80084EEC, which reads common movement attributes and updates fighter airborne velocity through common physics helpers; it does not update those attributes.

facts.rationale: Following the item consumer distinguishes position offset and spin scaling from the baseline's velocity and lifetime interpretations.
facts.value: On a throw event, samples joint 31 and calls it_802B2A10 with the fighter, position, part 0x1F and facing direction; stores the nullable result in x1984_heldItemSpec and u.ys.x2238 and conditionally installs interruption callbacks. Independently, nonzero cmd_vars[0] with a retained egg consumes that command, sets specialhi.x0, computes launch velocity through ftYs_SpecialS_8012DF8C, builds position offset (x104*facing_dir, x108, 0), and passes these with specialhi.x4*x110+x10C and raw charge to it_802B28C8. The item adds the offset to position and uses the scalar for spin scaling; its final raw-charge parameter is unused. The fighter then clears u.ys.x2238, take_dmg_cb and death2_cb.

facts.rationale: Corrects release-parameter semantics while preserving the callback's demonstrated lifecycle role and exceptional branches.
facts.value: Animation accessory callback for Egg Throw that creates and retains an egg on a throw event and releases a valid retained egg on command variable 0, supplying aimed launch velocity, a facing-relative position offset and charge-scaled spin input. Creation and release are independently guarded and can occur in one invocation. Successful release relinquishes u.ys.x2238 and the damage/death callbacks; the release scalar is not a charge-scaled lifetime.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported calculation while correcting stale field spelling and the truncated consumer symbol.
facts.value: Reads input.lstick[0].x, facing_dir, mv.ys.specialhi.x4 and attributes xEC, xF0, xF4, specialhi_base_angle, xFC and x100. It normalizes absolute horizontal stick displacement, caps it at one, scales and thresholds the angular adjustment, applies stick direction, selects a facing-dependent angle, and writes ((x4*x100+xFC)*cosf(angle), (x4*x100+xFC)*sinf(angle), 0) to the caller's Vec3. The accessory callback forwards that vector to it_802B28C8 when releasing the retained egg.

evidence.why: Trajectory, release, retention and tongue cleanup.

facts.rationale: Replaces the unsupported charge-scaled lifetime claim and makes the fighter/item retention boundary explicit.
facts.value: Egg Throw reads horizontal stick input, accumulated held-B duration, facing direction, throw and animation-command flags, and Yoshi attributes. It computes launch velocity, a facing-relative position offset and a charge-scaled spin input for the EggThrow item release routine, whose raw-charge parameter is unused. The fighter retains the egg and interruption callbacks before release and clears u.ys.x2238 and those callbacks after successful release. A separate SpecialN-aware path destroys a retained tongue article and clears x1A64 and target_item_gobj.
